candidates.description: The 2008 MLB AL Central Tiebreaker Game was played by the Minnesota Twins against the Chicago White Sox on 9-30 - 08 at US Cellular Field in Chicago. The White Sox defeated the Twins 1-0 and secured a place in the playoffs.

candidates.description: Adam Troy Dunn (born November 9, 1979), is an American Major League Baseball first baseman, outfielder, and designated hitter for the Chicago White Sox. He bats left-handed and throws right-handed. He is 6 feet 6 inches (1.98 m) in height and weighs 285 pounds (129 kg).
